name: Bloemhof
story: The view shifts toward the Vaal River and Bloemhof Dam. The town is more than a point between larger rail destinations.
history: Bloemhof is linked to a major Vaal River dam; its North West shore includes the Bloemhof Dam Nature Reserve.

experience.activity: Plan a birdwatching or nature visit to Bloemhof Dam Nature Reserve.
